name: phosphatidylinositol-4,5-bisphosphate 3-kinase catalytic subunit alpha

function.text: PIK3CA encodes the p110α catalytic subunit of class I phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase, which produces lipid signals that activate AKT-dependent growth and survival pathways.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Liposarcoma; Urachal carcinoma; Urothelial carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: PIK3CA encodes the p110α catalytic subunit of class I phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase, which produces lipid signals that activate AKT-dependent growth and survival pathways.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include overgrowth syndrome and/or cerebral malformations due to abnormalities in MTOR pathway genes (autosomal dominant).

mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with megalencephaly-capillary malformation-polymicrogyria syndrome.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PIK3CA have been reported in invasive breast carcinoma of no special type, endometrioid carcinoma of endometrium, and colorectal adenocarcinoma.
